old_problem: Pending inputs were GPU scope, pinned burn semantics and signed low-rail/health limits.
disposition_reason: ED-03 binds UUID/BDF/tool parameters, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves 12 hours, and ED-15 requires signed load and health limits beyond the final PASS string.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row57 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3091 and actual next row58/history3092 were read.
Every target GPU needs stable identity, pinned binary/config and continuous load proof.

test_case.test_name: GPU burn for 12 hours at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify every intended GPU sustains approved burn load at cold/low-rail margin without compute, XID, ECC, PCIe, thermal, power or platform failure.
required_package: Pinned burn binary/checksum/config and load floor
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, verify every GPU identity, run the pinned burn profile for 12 hours with continuous per-GPU telemetry, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Every target remains loaded, returns the approved PASS, violates no signed health/event limit and is healthy after restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all intended GPUs, full duration, pinned PASS semantics and independent health evidence; one GPU or final PASS alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/rail operator and OOB heartbeat
Controlled low-rail ramp and preserved logs
Abort on moisture, power/thermal, XID/ECC/AER or heartbeat limit
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry, restore GPU policies/services, verify inventory/health and do not auto-retry.
